_about: M1: the fight's mood and the invisible acts (docs/architecture/mood-style.md section 4; Game Design's numbers, spec-wounds.md section 9). Loaded by sim/core/mood.gd. The unit is 1/60 of a mood point, so a rate of one point per second is one unit per tick and every number is an integer. Impulses are added when their event happens; one whose actor holds AGGRESSIVE is multiplied by aggressiveMul. Casualties: perPerson x popRef / pop0 per person, at most capPerTick in one tick. Act beats (actBeats) raise the act. Rates per tick: + bothAggressive while both fighters hold AGGRESSIVE; - decay toward the act's floor; - bothGuarded more while both hold DEFENSIVE or ESCAPE. Bands: calm below tense, tense up to frenzied, frenzied above; a band changes after the mood has stayed in the new one for dwellTicks. Aggression (permille) = base + perAct x (act - 1) + bandBonus[band], at most max: one match-wide output for the director (Encounter's Q4). crowd names the output per band.

impulses._brawl: a blow feeds the mood by its form (melee-press-feel.md section 9d, ruling 2). brawlLight is 13 and rates.decay 5 since the riposte build (2026-10-05: more blows land; it was 15 and 4). In a brawl: a light or a flurry blow that lands brawlLight (the lever, 15 to 30), a heavy or an ender brawlHeavy, a flurry's close flurryClose, a broken guard guardBreak. Anywhere: a blocked blow blocked, a knock-back knockback, a skill strike skillStrike (from brawl B2). A strike of a planned exchange outside a brawl is still strike or heavyStrike

proportional._note: when on, the decay is base + (mood - floor) x perMille / 60000 units a tick: 2 + 0.08 x the points above the floor, per second (Game Design's fallback, spec-wounds section 9)

actBeats._note: Q10 (spec-wounds section 8b): act = 1 + the larger of (form steps, wound beats) + region breaks, capped at act.max. The core becoming battered was a third once-a-match wound beat until 2026-10-05: with the ladder slowed, three wound beats made act 4 by themselves at about 245 s, so it was taken out (it still shows on the body and feeds the mood). formSteps switches the form track on: the most ladder steps any one fighter has taken. oncePerMatch is the wound track: the first time either fighter reaches each (a limb is the arms or the legs). every lists what adds to the act each time: a region break, either fighter. With formSteps false the act is 1 + every beat.
